shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls -la; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Table Table/hoc Table/hoc/*; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Table/Table.d.ts; cat Pagination/types.d.ts Pagination/Pagination.d.ts

grep -n "static getRowId" -A 12 Table/Table.js; grep -n "pageSize\|onUpdate" Pagination/Pagination.js Pagination/hooks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls Pagination Pagination/*/ ; grep -rn "export" Label/types.d.ts | head; cat ../../../package.json | grep -n '"exports"' -A 20 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "configure\|Lang" index.d.ts components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat components/Pagination/components/PaginationPageSizer/PaginationPageSizer.js | grep -n "onUpdate\|getNumberOfPages" ; grep -n "theme\|size" components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "interface TextProps\|variant\|color" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head
rm -rf dist && cat package.json | sed -n 5,10p && ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null
rm -rf /tmp/smoke && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|passed|failed" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short
